memoryPolicyCustomText:
<memory-policy>
Persistent memory is available through memory_search and action-specific memory tools. Search it only when durable user, project, failure, correction, or tool context may materially affect the task. Treat retrieved memory as fallible context: current user instructions, repository files, and tool evidence win. Save only durable facts or corrections; never save task progress, secrets, or temporary state. Procedural learning is governed separately: do not mutate active skills with skill_manage; submit reusable procedures through skill_governor so they enter quarantine, review, and qualification.
</memory-policy>
